verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's own support docs describe exporting your data so you can use it elsewhere, in open formats (a CSV file or an unencrypted ZIP), plus an optional PGP-encrypted JSON ZIP. Export is available from the browser extensions, web app and Windows app. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every item type (attachments, passkeys, aliases) is included in the export, documentation of account deletion or offboarding, and independent hands-on corroboration of the export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: If you want to use your passwords elsewhere or create a separate hardcopy, you can easily export your data from Proton Pass.
A ZIP file containing a PGP-encrypted JSON file
You can export your data from Proton Pass via our browser extensions, web app, and Windows app.
